{{Quote|Coruscant may be the heart of the Republic, but the mind that dreams is right here on Arkania.|[[Arkoh Adasca]]|<ref name="KOTOR16" />}}
'''Arkania''' was the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was covered with tundra and rich in [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]] and other precious [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], which the Arkanians mined to further their offworld connections and master their technology. Arkanian cities were designed to keep the cold out and were mostly completely enclosed. Off-world visitors rarely had to deal with the frigid conditions of the planet. Many citizens were [[Mining/Legends|miners]].

==Description==
A harsh world of tundra and ice, Arkania was able to sustain life and civilization despite the harsh climate. Deep underground, the planet was filled with [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] stores considered extremely valuable by those on the surface, resulting in the excavation of extensive mines across the world.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
===Early mining operations and the Sith Empire===
[[File:Arkania.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Arkania in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]]]

Discovered by scouts from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000]] and [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], the frozen world of Arkania was home to a population of white-eyed [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] called the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]]. Home to massive [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] stores, Arkania opened these hidden vaults to mining industries associated with the Republic. The rich gem mines on their planet led to its great development and the construction of elaborate trade cities on Arkania.<ref name="AC">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030206arkania1|series=Arkanian Chill|text=Part 1: A Cold Reception}}</ref> This was the reason why Arkanian culture largely flourished as a result of off-world contact.<ref name="TEGAS" /> They were well known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for their extremely reclusive scientists and rumors soon abounded that these geneticists were not above experimentation on sentients. Indeed, one of their earliest known endeavors was the creation of the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] species from the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]]<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> around [[17,000 BBY]] while the Republic was cutoff from the world by the tumultuous [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Though they abandoned their clandestine experiments, fearing legal action from the Republic, the Quermians resurfaced millennium later.<ref name="UAA" />

The ancient capital [[Adascopolis]] served as the home of [[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania]], a corporation with a controlling interest in the planet and run by the [[House of Adasca]]. At this point in Arkania's history, the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Empire]] enveloped the planet in their iron-clad grip and established a massive library called [[Veeshas Tuwan]] circa [[7000 BBY]].<ref name="TEGAS" /> Drawing [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] from across the Empire, the library grew over the centuries as scientists would draw upon [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] magics to conduct their experiments. As the structure became so cavernous that no one could find what they were looking for; still Lords would practice their dark arts in hidden chambers far from the control of the Republic or the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The growth of the great library came to a fiery end at the conclusion of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] however. Following the exile of Sith Lord [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], the Jedi Order learned of the library's location and deemed it a threat to the stability of the Order and the Republic. Dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], a team of several [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] descended upon Arkania and destroyed Veeshas Tuwan, wiping out the Sith population and returning power to the Arkanians.<ref name="TOTJC" />

===Old Sith Wars===
[[File:ArcaJethsPraxeum-TEGtPaM.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Arca Jeth's praxeum]] on Arkania.]]

By the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the world was inhabited by not only pure-blood Arkanians, but genetically-engineered [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|offshoots]]. Inhabiting cities constructed over large stretches of frozen wastes, the pure-blooded Arkanians held great contempt for the offshoots and sent them into ghettos.<ref name="KOTOR16" /> Despite the adversity faced by many offshoots, the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Arca Jeth]], whose blood was mixed with the [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] race, rose to great prominence in the Jedi Order and attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. As the High Council became concerned with the re-emergence of the Sith, Master Jeth was dispatched to his homeworld to ensure that it did not fall back into the hands of the Order's sworn enemies. Establishing a [[Arca Jeth's praxeum|praxeum]] in the wilderness of the planet not far from a small city, Jeth cleansed the world of the remaining taint of the dark side and began training such famed Jedi as [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], [[Cay Qel-Droma]], and [[Tott Doneeta]]. Jeth fought in numerous campaigns ranging from the defeat of the [[Lorell Raiders]], the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]] and finally defending the Republic against the rise of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult.<ref name="TOTJC" />

A generation after the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and Arca Jeth's death, Adascorp's leader, Lord [[Arkoh Adasca]] implemented [[Project Black Harvest]] as a means of gaining further power for himself. During this illegal project, scientists such as the offshoot [[Gorman Vandrayk]] were forced to study the fabled [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorths]] which floated dormant in space. As the [[Mandalorian Wars]] began to tear at the fabric of peace in the Republic, Adascorp's activities on Arkania began to crescendo as the young Adasca put his final plan in motion but was halted by through the intervention of the failed Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and his band of criminals and misfits. With the death of Adasca and the destruction of the ''[[Arkanian Legacy]]'', Adascorp fell under the control of the [[Draay Trust]], established by Jedi Master [[Lucien Draay]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Daze of Hate">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Daze of Hate]]''</ref>

Despite Adasca's death, Adascorp did not disappear entirely. In the wake of the [[Great Galactic War]], the corporation emerged to assist the Republic during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Aiding the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] in preparing a trap for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt|Grand Champion]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], members of Adascorp worked side by side with Jedi Master [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] in preparing to capture the [[Hunter (individual)|deadly and elusive warrior]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

===The Arkanian Revolution===
[[File:Arkania_mining_camp.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Former Arkanian mining camp as of [[3963 BBY]]]]
Following the Cold War Arkania remained deeply in the fold of the Republic, and despite the chaos and anarchy of the [[New Sith Wars]], the planet did not return to the Sith thrall. As the Republic grew stronger, the [[Arkanian Dominion]] also grew in power on Arkania and experimentation expanded almost unfettered. Developing a reputation as a species made up entirely of mad scientists, Arkanian society was greatly threatened by the discovery of the experiments being conducted on the neighboring [[Yaka]] species. The culmination of the social outrage plaguing Arkania came to fruition in [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]] when a group of scientists known as the [[Arkanian Renegades]] attempted a coup against the Dominion in what came to be known as the [[Arkanian Revolution]]. Funded and supplied by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] by smuggling weapons and ammunition from the planet [[Dreddon]], these scientists designed cybernetic warriors to wage war against the Dominion and put an end to the lawlessness of the scientific engine on the planet. When the coup failed, a brutal civil war erupted on the planet and the Dominion was forced to call upon the Jedi Order for assistance in ending it. In response, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Aqinos]], the latter considered a rogue among the Order for the training of his so-called [[Iron Knight]]s. Aided by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-Jedi, Master Windu was able to defeat the famed warrior [[Gorm (cyborg)|Gorm the Dissolver]] in a savage duel. As the war ended, the Dominion remained in power and the Renegades were all executed leaving Jabba with a surplus of weapons. Gorm survived his duel with Windu and escaped execution, and the Jedi suffered minor losses. Returning to Coruscant, the Iron Knights were made [[High Marshal]]s of the Republic by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Frix]], while being excommunicated by the Jedi Order for their straying from the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]].<ref name="NEGTD" />

===Rise of the Empire===
[[File:Arkania_surface.png|thumb|right|200px|The frigid surface of Arkania]]
{{Quote|I wouldn't miss this for all the diamonds in Arkania!|Common spacer saying|<ref name="EGPM" />}}
As thoughts of rebellion dwindled, life on Arkania returned to normal and the diamond mines continued to flourish. [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]] tournaments were held often on the planet and the Jedi Order saw an influx of students entering its [[Jedi academy|academies]]. Staunch and vocal supporters of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the Arkanian senators strongly opposed the ideals of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="UAA" /> By this time, Arkania had largely directed its scientific resources to the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] industry; establishing many large therapeutic cloning centers which specialized in generating replacement organs for those individuals suffering major afflictions.<ref name="RCTC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy, the Galactic Senate unveiled its [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] created from the facilities on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Disgusted by the Republic's use of the army, the respected Arkanian [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Serifa Altunen]] forswore her oath to the Order and returned to her homeworld in an effort to keep Arkania neutral in the war. The High Council dispatched Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to bring her back, but Altunen could not be swayed as she believed she was being guided by the Force.<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> Much to the dismay of the Arkanian government, the Senate eventually voted to halt all non-military cloning with [[Decree E49D139.41]]; despite initial fears, certain exemptions were made and Arkanian could continue to produce cloned technology with a license, but were prohibited from exporting it.<ref name="RCTC" /> The war never came to Arkania, due to strict patrols by the [[Third Mid Rim Army|3rd Sector Army]], and Arkania remained unspoiled by battle.<ref name="EGTW" />

Suffering economically from the cloning ban, despite provisions for it to continue on their world, Arkania had no choice but to submit to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when it rose from the ashes of the Republic at the end of the war. While the Arkanian Dominion played no role in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], some members of the species joined the Empire in secret laboratories of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] helping develop [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]] for the Imperial military machine. When the Empire collapsed, the Arkanians refrained from joining the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] due to fear of major, stricter sanctions on their scientific fields.<ref name="AA" /> Despite their stance against the Republic, Arkanians did work with the government to wipe out [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]] after the pests destroyed an Arkanian colony in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]. In the ensuing years, the galaxy was invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], a species of aliens who declared [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] on the civilized galaxy. In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] a fierce [[Assault on Arkania|battle]] was fought over Arkania, with the alien invaders ultimately capturing and occupying the world.<ref name="TEA" />

Upon the defeat of the Yuuzhan Vong in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Arkania was eventually liberated and joined the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in order to ensure their recovery. As of [[127 ABY]], Arkania was under the control of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Arkania in the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
